highlights:
# Scotland vs Ivory Coast Prediction and Betting Tips | March 31st 2026
[...]
Scotland and Ivory Coast continue their preparations for the upcoming FIFA World Cup when they lock horns in an international friendly at Hill Dickinson Stadium on Tuesday. Both sides picked up contrasting results at the weekend, with Les Elephants claiming a dominant victory over South Korea.
[...]
Scotland kicked off their friendly preparations for the World Cup on a sour note last weekend when they fell to a 1-0 defeat at the hands of Japan.
[...]
This followed a solid run in the World Cup qualifiers, where they picked up four wins and one draw from their six games in Group C to clinch top spot and an automatic ticket to the global tournament.
[...]
Scotland will follow Tuesday’s tie with their final warm-up game against Curacao on May 30, before taking on Haiti in the Group C opener of the World Cup on June 14.
[...]
On the other hand, Ivory Coast turned in a solid team display last Saturday, when they cruised to a 4-0 victory over South Korea at Stadium MK.
[...]
This followed a somewhat disappointing run in the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations, where Les Elephants crashed out in the quarter-finals courtesy of a narrow 3-2 loss against record champions Egypt.
[...]
Ivory Coast have been drawn in Group E of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, alongside Ecuador, four-time champions Germany, and debutants Curacao.
[...]
## Scotland vs Ivory Coast Head-To-Head and Key Numbers
[...]
- This will be the very first meeting between Scotland and the Ivory Coast, and both nations will look to begin their rivalry on a positive note.
- Ivory Coast are unbeaten in eight of their most recent nine friendly outings, picking up six victories and one draw since March 2024.
- Scotland have won just two of their last nine friendly matches since September 2023, while losing six and claiming one draw in that time.
- Ivory Coast are unbeaten in six of their most recent eight away games across all competitions, picking up five wins and one draw since June 2025.
[...]
## Scotland vs Ivory Coast Prediction
[...]
Scotland and the Ivory Coast are expected to name a shuffled XI on Tuesday, but we expect both sides to be up for the challenge at the Hill Dickinson Stadium.
[...]
Ivory Coast are unbeaten in six of their last seven matches in all competitions, and we are backing them to come out on top in a thrilling contest.
[...]
Prediction: Scotland 1-2 Ivory Coast
[...]
## Scotland vs Ivory Coast Betting Tips
[...]
Tip 1: Result - Ivory Coast to win
[...]
Tip 2: Over 2.5 goals - Yes (There have been three or more goals scored in four of Scotland’s last five outings)
[...]
Tip 3: Both sides to score - Yes (Both sides have also scored in four of Scotland's last five games)

results.title: Ivory Coast vs Scotland – Match preview and team news
highlights:
Scotland take on Ivory Coast in an international friendly on Tuesday as both sides continue their preparations for the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The match will be played at Everton’s Hill Dickinson Stadium in Liverpool.
[...]
Ivory Coast vs
[...]
- Date: Tuesday, 30th March.
- Kick-off: 6:30pm BST.
- Venue: Hill Dickinson Stadium, Liverpool.
[...]
Strasbourg left winger Martial Godo made an eye-catching debut with a goal and an assist in the 4-0 win over South Korea, and he could be rewarded with another start.
[...]
There could also be a debut in attack, with Nice striker Elye Wahi named in the squad for the first time and possibly given an opportunity to prove himself on the international stage.
[...]
In midfield, Nottingham Forest’s Ibrahim Sangaré may be recalled to the starting XI after beginning on the bench against Korea. Wilfried Singo is an option to return to the defence after missing the 2026 Africa Cup of Nations through injury.
[...]
Scotland boss Steve Clarke has made it clear he wanted a test against African opposition before facing Morocco in the second game of their World Cup campaign, so he is likely to field as strong a side as possible against the 2023 AFCON champions.
[...]
As a result, there may be few changes from the team that faced Japan. The disappointing nature of that performance means a number of places are still up for grabs.
[...]
Ryan Christie, Kieran Tierney, Billy Gilmour, Anthony Ralston, George Hirst and John Souttar could all be in line to start.
[...]
The biggest question remains up front. Lyndon Dykes was replaced by George Hirst after around an hour in that match, and the Ipswich Town striker could be given the nod to lead the line.
[...]
Tommy Conway will also be hoping for a chance after being used out wide. Che Adams remains an experienced alternative for Clarke to consider.
[...]
Ivory Coast come into the game with the momentum of a World Cup-qualified side and has been using friendlies to fine-tune its squad ahead of the summer.
[...]
Their recent focus has been on squad balance and integration. Their most recent outing was a comfortable win against South Korea (4-0).
[...]
Scotland’s most recent outing ended in a 1-0 loss to Japan, leaving Clarke’s side with work to do in terms of creativity and tempo.
[...]
Before that, the Scots had secured World Cup qualification in dramatic fashion, which underlined their resilience and ability to handle pressure in big moments.
[...]

Ivory Coast vs Scotland predictions: International tips and odds
[...]
### Ivory Coast vs Scotland tips
[...]
Ivory Coast and Scotland will meet in an international friendly at Everton’s Hill Dickinson Stadium in Liverpool on Tuesday night (kick-off 7.30pm). Our tipster Dan Fitch is expecting goals from both teams and for Amad Diallo to shine.
[...]
Both teams to score @ 10/11
[...]
What: Ivory Coast vs Scotland, international friendly Where: Hill Dickinson Stadium When: 7.30pm, Tuesday, March 31 Watch: BBC Scotland and BBC Two
[...]
### Ivory Coast are on a scoring streak
[...]
Scotland drew a blank last week as they lost 1-0 against Japan at Hampden Park. It was an uninspiring display from Steve Clarke’s side that even drew some boos from the Tartan Army at the end of the match.
[...]
So you’d imagine that Clarke and his side will be fired up and eager to put in a better performance when they meet the Ivory Coast on Tuesday night, with this game taking place on neutral territory at Everton’s Hill Dickinson Stadium.
[...]
Ivory Coast were also in friendly action last week and their World Cup preparations went much more smoothly as they thrashed South Korea 4-0.
[...]
The Africans have been scoring a lot of goals in recent games. They have found the net in each of their last seven outings and have scored 12 times in their last four fixtures.
[...]
With Scotland having conceded in each of their last five matches, Les Elephants’ scoring streak should continue. I’m avoiding trying to predict the result of a game in which the respective coaches are likely to rotate, but both teams to score could be value at 10/11.
[...]
### Amad starting to produce on the international stage
[...]
Amad Diallo came off the bench for the Ivory Coast against South Korea and assisted Wilfried Slingo’s goal in added time, which completed the 4-0 rout.
[...]
The Manchester United star has been very impressive for his country this season and should now enjoy a start against Scotland.
[...]
Amad has a decent record of five goals and three assists from 17 international appearances, which looks even better when you consider that he has only started 10 of those games.
[...]
Drill down into his recent record and the numbers are very solid. The winger has four goals and three assists from his last nine matches for his country, of which six were starts.
[...]
I was tempted to back Amad to score at generous odds of 3/1. Instead, I’m playing it safe and going with him to score or assist, which is still an attractive price at 6/4.
